description: Header file defining functions for forward lock cryptographic operations, including random number generation, key encryption/decryption, and key length calculation, used in Android's DRM framework.

methods.name: FwdLockGlue_InitializeKeyEncryption
methods.description: Initializes key-encryption key for session encryption/decryption.

methods.name: FwdLockGlue_GetEncryptedKeyLength
methods.description: Calculates length of encrypted key from plaintext key length.

methods.name: FwdLockGlue_EncryptKey
methods.description: Encrypts a session key using device-specific key-encryption key.

methods.name: FwdLockGlue_DecryptKey
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted session key using device-specific key-encryption key.
